summary.text: Shelley Buck is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 47A, in office since February 2026 after winning a special election, and is running for a full term on November 3, 2026. Ballotpedia lists no opponent on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: Shelley Buck, also known as Pte Wicota, earned a bachelor's degree in accounting from Indiana University, a master's degree in sports management from Concordia University, and a master's degree in Indian law from the University of Tulsa.
Ballotpedia says her career includes work as a nonprofit leader.
Buck defeated Juli Servatius, an Unaffiliated write-in candidate, in the special general election for District 47A on January 27, 2026, and assumed office on February 3, 2026.
